title: Firework Delay Fixed
description: Firework Delay reduces the delay when using Firework Rockets caused by network latency, making Firework usage feel faster and more responsive, especially on high-ping connections.
body:
# Firework Delay

Firework Delay is a lightweight client-side mod that reduces the delay when using Firework Rockets caused by network latency.

Players with higher ping often experience a noticeable delay before a Firework Rocket activates. This mod minimizes that delay, making Firework usage feel faster, smoother, and more responsive while keeping the experience simple and lightweight.

## Features

- 🚀 Reduces Firework Rocket use delay.
- ⚡ Improves responsiveness on high-ping connections.
- 🪶 Lightweight with no unnecessary features.
- 🔧 Easy to install and use.

## Compatibility

- Client-side mod.
- Works best on servers where latency causes noticeable Firework delay.
